title: WTC 7 competing collapse-model audit
question: Given public NIST, UAF, FEMA, and UCL materials, which claims about WTC 7 collapse initiation and propagation are directly supported, model-dependent, or underdetermined, and what matched tests would discriminate them?
decision: Prioritize public-record retrieval and reproducible experiments that can distinguish competing collapse mechanisms without treating any model output as historical proof.
minimum_evidence: A reviewed, source-pinned comparison that preserves competing models, assumptions, falsifiers, missing inputs, and result limits.
decision_change_criteria: Lower confidence in a proposed mechanism if a source-pinned matched simulation fails under its declared assumptions.
Do not elevate a prescribed support-removal comparator to a historical cause without independent evidence of an initiating mechanism.
Revise the ranking if independently reproduced multiview predictions materially favor one mechanism under shared geometry and event definitions.
available_data_sources: Public NIST NCSTAR 1A, 1-9, and 1-9A reports and public NIST FAQs/errata.
Public Hulsey, Quan, and Xiao 2020 UAF technical report.
Public Orabi et al. 2022 Fire Technology paper and its open manuscript.
Repository research notes only as pointers to their underlying public sources.
unavailable_data: NIST full simulation results, connection calculations, break-element code, and complete model handoff materials.
A locally executable, source-pinned UAF model archive with exact case-entry decks and run histories.
Camera-original or equivalently authenticated video records and a shared model-render/view package.
Authenticated physical evidence linking any prescribed support-removal scenario to a historical mechanism.
data_access_constraints: Do not transmit litigation correspondence, private metadata, credentials, or protected records.
Do not contact agencies or third parties, submit requests, publish findings, or treat generated records as evidence.
data_provenance_plan: Hash acquired public source bytes, record URLs and page/section locations, preserve missing-input status, and keep model assumptions distinct from observed evidence.
intervention: Competing model assumptions and prescribed failure mechanisms
comparison: NIST Column 79/fire sequence, UAF connection/progression objections and prescribed support-removal comparator, UCL mechanical-room fire feasibility pathway, and an explicit underdetermined/null category
outcome: Source-pinned claim ledger and falsification-oriented experiment specification
unit_of_observation: Distinct source-supported proposition or reproducible simulation run
sampling_plan: No statistical sampling. Include every prespecified public source family and preserve contrary results.
randomization_plan: Not applicable; this is an observational/model-comparison audit.
controls: Common geometry and connection assumptions where executable models become available
A prescribed-support-removal comparator without causal attribution
confounds: Different connection geometry and boundary conditions
Different video sources, viewpoints, timing conventions, and event definitions
Selection of scenarios after viewing target trajectories
calibration_plan: Do not use kinematic measurements until source video, frame timing, camera geometry, and physical-point identity have explicit validity checks.
measurement_validity: Every material statement must identify whether it is a direct observation, derived calculation, model-dependent output, inference, or hypothesis and name a falsifier.
analysis_commitment: Compare claims under a shared ledger; do not aggregate visual similarity or treat missing data as support for any mechanism.
stopping_rule: Stop each iteration after it either produces a source-pinned falsification test, identifies an indispensable unavailable input, or finds that the proposed claim is not discriminating.
exclusions: Claims of intentional demolition without independent physical, operational, or authenticated-record evidence
Unverified public commentary presented as source evidence
Any inference from model animation alone to historical causation
